scenarios.title: Native source/cargo/receipt one SQLite COMMIT
steps: Use persistent original native miner and rock in disposable Perimeter
Enable atomic flags and mine one exact cycle
Inspect same sqlite COMMIT and entity/rock/cargo IDs
expected: Rock decreases by normal+wasted; cargo rises by exact rewarded quantity
Immutable cycle receipt exists only once

scenarios.title: Crash before BEGIN IMMEDIATE
steps: Inject process exit immediately before SQLite BEGIN
Restart disposable world
expected: No source decrease and no cargo increase

scenarios.title: Crash during source mutation before cargo row
steps: Kill disposable game process in transaction before cargo write
Restart sqlite and read both tables
expected: Whole transaction rolled back; no partial source or cargo

scenarios.title: Kill during COMMIT or WAL fsync
steps: Inject kill during SQLite WAL commit with synchronous FULL
Restart sqlite on disposable copy
Check receipt source and cargo together
expected: Either all 3 persisted or none; no partial committed source/cargo

scenarios.title: Committed DB but lost scene update
steps: Commit native SQLite and abort prior to applyMiningDelta visual reconciliation
Resume exact original operation after restart
expected: Same committed receipt; no additional cargo or source debit

scenarios.title: Same cycle duplicate callback
steps: Replay exact target/miner/module/cycle boundary in native runtime
expected: Exactly one unique receipt, one rock debit, one cargo credit

scenarios.title: Two miners compete for same rock
steps: Mine same original asteroid with two independent native persistent ships
Race cycles with the same source preimage
expected: One wins CAS; other fails closed without cargo credit or overdraw

scenarios.title: Native cargo owner/quantity conflict
steps: Inject native cargo row owner mismatch on disposable source
Execute original mining module
expected: No alteration of foreign owner, rock, or quantity

scenarios.title: Physical NPC identity restart
steps: Restart persistent miner and source asteroid with original IDs
Recover native entity/controller and live cargo
expected: Same original miner shipID and cargoID; no duplicate spawn

scenarios.title: Native miner to hauler to warehouse and two clients
steps: Mine verifiable ore with atomic transaction and two original clients
Transfer cargo to original native hauler once
Dock and reconcile #110 warehouse receipt
expected: One source debit, one cargo ID custody transfer, one warehouse itemStore credit
Two authorized clients see same ship and world
